  IsLeast {n | S n > T} (k * p + r) := by
  have _ := hperiod
  constructor
  · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have h1 : S (k * p + r) = k * b + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, u i := hblock k r
    rw [h1]
    exact hcross
  · intro n hn
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hn

    push_neg at h_not_le

      calc n / p * p + n % p = n % p + n / p * p := Nat.add_comm _ _
        _ = n % p + p * (n / p) := by rw [hcomm]
        _ = n := h
    have h_S_eq : S n = n / p * b + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n % p), u i := by
      calc S n = S (n / p * p + n % p) := by rw [h_eq_mod]
        _ = n / p * b + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n % p), u i := hblock (n / p) (n % p)
    have h_lt2 : n / p * p + n % p < k * p + r := by
      rw [h_eq_mod]
      exact h_lt
    have h_le : n / p * b + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n % p), u i ≤ T :=
      hbound (n / p) (n % p) h_lt2
